        function resolveMosIconKey(el) {
            if (!el || !el.classList) return null;
            for (var key in MOS_ICON_SVGS) {
                if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(MOS_ICON_SVGS, key) && el.classList.contains(key)) {
                    return key;
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        function renderMosIcons(root) {
            var scope = root && root.querySelectorAll ? root : document;
            if (!scope || !scope.querySelectorAll) return;
            var icons = scope.querySelectorAll('i.fa-solid, i.fa-regular, i.fa-brands');
            icons.forEach(function(icon) {
                var key = resolveMosIconKey(icon);
                if (!key) {
                    if (icon.dataset && icon.dataset.mosIconKey) {
                        icon.dataset.mosIconKey = '';
                        icon.classList.remove('mos-svg-icon');
                        icon.innerHTML = '';
                    }
                    return;
                }
                if (icon.dataset && icon.dataset.mosIconKey === key && icon.innerHTML.trim()) return;
                icon.classList.add('mos-svg-icon');
                icon.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
                if (icon.dataset) icon.dataset.mosIconKey = key;
                icon.innerHTML = MOS_ICON_SVGS[key];
            });
        }

        window.renderMosIcons = renderMosIcons;

        // ---- STATE ----
        var selectedFlavor = 'watermelon';
        var selectedQty = '3x';

        function syncSelectedVariantInputs() {
            var flavorInput = document.getElementById('mos-selected-flavor');
            var packInput = document.getElementById('mos-selected-pack');
            if (flavorInput) flavorInput.value = selectedFlavor;
            if (packInput) packInput.value = selectedQty;
        }

        // ---- FLAVOR SELECTOR ----
        function selectFlavor(labelEl, flavor) {
            selectedFlavor = flavor;
            var container = document.getElementById('flavor-selector');
            var allCards = container.querySelectorAll('.radio-card');

            allCards.forEach(function(card) {
                card.classList.remove('selected');
                // Reset indicator
                var indicator = card.querySelector('.radio-indicator-inline');
                if (indicator) {
                    indicator.className = 'radio-indicator-inline w-4 h-4 border-2 border-gray-300 rounded-full bg-white flex-shrink-0';
                    indicator.innerHTML = '';
                }
                card.classList.add('text-gray-600');
                card.classList.remove('text-gray-900');
            });

            var activeCard = labelEl.querySelector('.radio-card');
            activeCard.classList.add('selected');
            activeCard.classList.remove('text-gray-600');
            activeCard.classList.add('text-gray-900');

            var activeIndicator = activeCard.querySelector('.radio-indicator-inline');
            if (activeIndicator) {
                activeIndicator.className = 'radio-indicator-inline w-4 h-4 border-2 border-brand-link rounded-full relative flex items-center justify-center bg-white flex-shrink-0';
                activeIndicator.innerHTML = '<div class="radio-dot w-2 h-2 bg-brand-link rounded-full"></div>';
            }

            syncSelectedVariantInputs();
            updateCTA();
        }

        // ---- QUANTITY SELECTOR ----
        function selectQuantity(labelEl, qty) {
            selectedQty = qty;
            var container = document.getElementById('quantity-selector');
            var allCards = container.querySelectorAll('.radio-card');

            allCards.forEach(function(card) {
                card.classList.remove('selected', 'shadow-md');
            });

            var activeCard = labelEl.querySelector('.radio-card');
            activeCard.classList.add('selected');
            if (qty === '3x') activeCard.classList.add('shadow-md');

            syncSelectedVariantInputs();
            updateCTA();
        }

        // ---- UPDATE CTA BUTTON TEXT ----
        function updateCTA() {
            var btn = document.getElementById('main-cta');
            var buyOnceLink = document.getElementById('buy-once-link');
            var prices = { '1x': '$42', '2x': '$64', '3x': '$89' };
            btn.innerHTML = 'START MY PROTOCOL — ' + prices[selectedQty] + ' <i class="fa-solid fa-circle-arrow-right"></i>';
            if (window.renderMosIcons) window.renderMosIcons(btn);
            if (buyOnceLink) {
                buyOnceLink.textContent = 'BUY ONCE FOR ' + prices[selectedQty] + ' + FREE SHIPPING';
            }
        }

        // ---- FAQ ACCORDION ----
        function toggleFaq(el) {
            var answer = el.querySelector('.faq-answer');
            var icon = el.querySelector('.faq-icon');

            if (answer.style.display === 'none' || !answer.style.display) {
                answer.style.display = 'block';
                answer.style.marginTop = '8px';
                icon.classList.remove('fa-plus');
                icon.classList.add('fa-minus');
            } else {
                answer.style.display = 'none';
                icon.classList.remove('fa-minus');
                icon.classList.add('fa-plus');
            }
            if (window.renderMosIcons) window.renderMosIcons(el);
        }

        // Init CTA on load
        updateCTA();
        syncSelectedVariantInputs();
        renderMosIcons(document);

        // ---- MOBILE QUALITY BANNER ROTATOR ----
        (function() {
            var mobileTrack = document.getElementById('mobile-marquee-track');
            if (!mobileTrack) return;

            var slideCount = mobileTrack.children.length;
            if (slideCount < 2) return;

            var reducedMotionQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
            var activeIndex = 0;
            var timerId = null;
            var isAnimating = false;
            var mobileBreakpoint = 767;

            function isMobileViewport() {
                return window.innerWidth <= mobileBreakpoint;
            }

            function setTrackPosition(index, animate) {
                mobileTrack.style.transition = animate ? 'transform 320ms ease' : 'none';
                mobileTrack.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + (-index * 100) + '%, 0, 0)';
            }

            function stopMobileMarquee() {
                if (timerId) {
                    window.clearInterval(timerId);
                    timerId = null;
                }
            }

            function resetMobileMarquee() {
                activeIndex = 0;
                isAnimating = false;
                setTrackPosition(activeIndex, false);
            }

            function startMobileMarquee() {
                stopMobileMarquee();
                resetMobileMarquee();
                if (!isMobileViewport() || reducedMotionQuery.matches) return;

                timerId = window.setInterval(function() {
                    if (isAnimating) return;
                    isAnimating = true;
                    activeIndex += 1;
                    setTrackPosition(activeIndex, true);
                }, 1600);
            }

            mobileTrack.addEventListener('transitionend', function() {
                if (activeIndex >= slideCount - 1) {
                    activeIndex = 0;
                    setTrackPosition(activeIndex, false);
                }
                isAnimating = false;
            });

            document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() {
                if (document.hidden) {
                    stopMobileMarquee();
                    return;
                }
                startMobileMarquee();
            });

            window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
                startMobileMarquee();
            });

            if (typeof reducedMotionQuery.addEventListener === 'function') {
                reducedMotionQuery.addEventListener('change', startMobileMarquee);
            } else if (typeof reducedMotionQuery.addListener === 'function') {
                reducedMotionQuery.addListener(startMobileMarquee);
            }

            startMobileMarquee();
        })();
    </script>
